title: Who wrote Mood Indigo
summary: Smith raises the Bigard claim; Goodwin says there was little doubt locally that Ellington wrote it but no proof either way.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: What was the feeling at the time -- many years ago here in Kansas city with the Kansas City musicians about the controversy of who wrote "Mood Indigo"? Many people, including Barney Bigard Bonnie Bigard and Mrs. Bigard, have said that Barney wrote "Mood Indigo" and of course every credit is given to Duke Ellington. What was the feeling or was there any discussion of this years ago?
There wasn't too much discussion. There wasn't too much doubt that Duke Ellington didn't write it --

-- but I have heard -- I can't -- don't want you to quote me on it, but I have heard that Barney Bonnie did write the song. But in these instances you have no proof unless the man's name is on the number.
